description.value: D'oro Gelato e Caffè is a multiple-award-winning Italian gelateria and full-service café on Denman Street, producing small-batch handmade gelato and sorbetto daily from original Sicilian recipes. Beyond gelato, it serves full meals including freshly baked pastries, paninos, soups, and salads alongside artisan espresso drinks from Seattle-based Caffè Umbria. Situated close to Stanley Park and the Seawall, it sits along one of Vancouver's most popular recreational cycling corridors.
